# Full-view goldens

`<tool>.golden` is the JSON text block and `<tool>.structured.json` the
structured output a caller with full view receives from each people tool for
the registry's fixtures (`people_tools_registry_test.go`); the
`<case>.requests.golden` files record the upstream requests of
`fullViewCallCases`. They were generated by running the registry's setups
against the handlers at origin/main `6eeebb2`, before the people rule existed,
and are regenerated only from a checkout that predates that rule, never from a
branch under test: they prove the rule never narrows a full-view caller.

One exception, by decision: `get_past_meeting.golden` and
`get_past_meeting.structured.json` were regenerated from the branch of
lfx-self-serve#2656 (artifact file details without links), which replaced the
raw recording and transcript documents with a projection that carries no link
and no people field for any caller. For this tool the pair pins that decision;
full view and the caller's own view produce the same output. Regenerate it
from a throwaway generator over the registry entry when its fixtures change.
